summary: Species deck to physical equilibrium, loss-cone branches, signed gyrofrequency, rational poles and finite scan controls.

identity.definition: Convert q/e and m/mp to SI, temperatures eV to K and drift/c to m/s; vt_parallel=sqrt(2 kB Tparallel/m), omega_c=qB0/m, omega_p^2=nq^2/(epsilon0 m), cwp=c/omega_p1. Retain alpha==1 Maxwellian branch and separate polar/Cartesian par entries. Source constant profile: c=2.9979e8 m/s, epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m, kB=1.3807e-23 J/K, qe=1.6022e-19 C, mp=1.6726e-27 kg; mu0=1/(c^2 epsilon0). Deck charge is q/qe, mass is m/mp, temperatures are eV, parallel drift is vd/c. These source approximations intentionally differ from other runtime profiles.
identity.model: Uniform magnetized, nonrelativistic charged Gaussian species with optional gyrotropic loss-cone mixture; B0 along signed z and k=(kx,0,kz).
identity.geometry: Cartesian k=(kx,0,kz), B0 along signed z; non-spatial representation for pole/partition operators.
identity.coordinates: SI angular frequency rad/s and wave number m^-1; normalized source scan/selection quantities are labeled explicitly.
identity.boundary: Uniform/local plane-wave response; no spatial boundary-value problem or nonlinear saturation.
assumptions: Caller retains the explicit truncation, state provenance and normalization.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.constraints: S>=1; charged q!=0,m>0,n>=0 with first n>0,Tparallel/Tperp/alpha>0,Delta in[0,1],abs(vd/c)<1; finite representable binary64. None loads packaged scenario deck.

inputs.name: scenario
inputs.description: Packaged scientific setup and seed prescription.
inputs.constraints: One of default,beammode,coldplasma,dispersionsurface,es1d_beam,es3d_losscone,loss_cone_mirror; each retains its own source setup.

inputs.name: controls
inputs.description: Explicit overrides after scenario setup and before initialization.
inputs.units: mixed; B0 T,wg0 omega/wcs1,angles degree,k coordinates k*cwp
inputs.constraints: Only iem,N,J,sp,wg0,B0,ipa,ipb,iloga,ilogb,pa1,pa2,dpa,pb1,pb2,dpb,iout. iem0/1,J4/8/12,Ninteger>=0,sp0/1,iout1/2; B0,dpa,dpb nonzero; scan pairs(1,1),(2,2),(3,3),(4,4),(1,2),(3,4). None preserves scenario defaults; default scenario uses N3,J8,B0=1e-7,sp0,wg0=1.5+.01i,ipa=ipb3,linear pa0:.01:1,iout1.

inputs.name: par
inputs.description: Independent six-coordinate state override, without implicit synchronization between polar and Cartesian entries.
inputs.constraints: Entries1..4 are normalized k,angle,kz,kx. Entries5..6 retain source slots; no new scanned physics is inferred. None preserves scenario setup.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: Immutable result state mapping with native physical variables and source-shaped diagnostics.
outputs.units: mixed:SI state variables and explicit dimensionless source controls
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: wcs
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: wps2
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

outputs.name: rsab
outputs.constraints: Accessible in returned NativeResult.state; scientific meaning applies only to a compatible completed predecessor. Empty inactive arrays are preserved.

preconditions: Charged positive-mass finite-temperature species, nonzero signed B0 and positive reference density.
supported: Charged positive-mass finite-temperature species, nonzero signed B0 and positive reference density.
excluded: Global nonlinear plasma evolution and a guarantee of unique physical mode identification.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Declared Python guards raise ValueError; incomplete or inconsistent state may raise KeyError or a native indexing/domain error. No silent physical-model substitution.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError records unavailable/failed/timed-out Octave execution. source_output additionally raises SourceOutputError with retained result and receipt when its caught scientific terminal fails.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Eigen/interpolation/selection native failure is observable; no failed root is converted to a successful mode. This operator does not certify global root convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Completed NativeResult carries immutable state and receipt. source_output failures expose partial artifacts through exception.result; other failed native calls do not promise a completed scientific state.

example.description: Small wheel-only example using packaged native resources and raw Octave; no source checkout or network.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk import magnetized as m, workflows as w
deck=np.array([[1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0],[-1,1,1e6,100,100,1,1,0.]])
controls=dict(B0=1e-7,N=1,J=4,sp=0,iem=1,iout=2,ipa=3,ipb=3,iloga=0,ilogb=0,pa1=.2,pa2=.4,dpa=.1)
eq=m.initialize_equilibrium(deck,controls=controls,par=[.2,0,.2,0,0,0])
assert int(eq.state['S'].item())==2
example.expected: NOT_RUN (environment): the example requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64; this macOS checkout has no octave executable, so NativeExecutionError is expected and no scientific result is claimed.

scope: SI conversion and first-species normalization, signed gyrofrequency and loss-cone branch state are bound to the preserved source convention.
Independent physical response and analytic-axis checks exercise the initialized canonical/holdout species; malformed physical deck and controls are rejected.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct contract tests and the declared finite cases bound the relation only where their numeric gates apply; native PDRK execution requires GNU Octave on Linux amd64 and is NOT_RUN in this macOS checkout.
known_limitations: Local technical development; human scientific endorsement and publication clearance remain pending.
Finite harmonic N and rational-pole J approximations require independent convergence checks for a new physical regime.
Passing bounded response, state and backward-error tests does not establish unique physical-mode tracking, all-root forward accuracy or visual acceptance.
Native example and full PDRK qualification require GNU Octave on Linux amd64; current macOS run is NOT_RUN.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
